data.phu_de: Here's a puzzle. | Dolphins are mammals, | so they need air to breathe. | But they live in the ocean. | So how do they sleep | without drowning?

scenes.text: Here's a puzzle. Dolphins are mammals, so they need air to breathe. But they live in the ocean. So how do they sleep without drowning?

data.phu_de: Humans breathe automatically. | You never have to think | about it. | A dolphin's breath is voluntary. | Every single breath | is a conscious decision. | Fall completely asleep, | and a dolphin | would stop breathing.

scenes.text: Humans breathe automatically. You never have to think about it. A dolphin's breath is voluntary. Every single breath is a conscious decision. Fall completely asleep, and a dolphin would stop breathing.

data.phu_de: So dolphins evolved | a clever workaround. | They sleep with only half | of their brain at a time. | The other half stays awake. | Scientists call it | unihemispheric slow-wave sleep.

scenes.text: So dolphins evolved a clever workaround. They sleep with only half of their brain at a time. The other half stays awake. Scientists call it unihemispheric slow-wave sleep.

data.phu_de: The sleeping half rests, | while the awake half | stays on duty. | And here is the giveaway. | A sleeping dolphin | keeps one eye open. | The eye on the opposite side | of the sleeping half, | watching for predators.

scenes.text: The sleeping half rests, while the awake half stays on duty. And here is the giveaway. A sleeping dolphin keeps one eye open. The eye on the opposite side of the sleeping half, watching for predators.

data.phu_de: They drift near the surface, | resting motionless | or swimming slowly, | and rise every few minutes | for a calm, easy breath. | Over a full day, | each half of the brain | gets about four hours of sleep.

scenes.text: They drift near the surface, resting motionless or swimming slowly, and rise every few minutes for a calm, easy breath. Over a full day, each half of the brain gets about four hours of sleep.

data.phu_de: New mothers | do not get that luxury. | For a whole month | after a calf is born, | mother and baby | barely sleep at all.

scenes.text: New mothers do not get that luxury. For a whole month after a calf is born, mother and baby barely sleep at all.

data.phu_de: Half a brain asleep. | One eye open. | And still breathing. | That is how a dolphin sleeps | without drowning.

scenes.text: Half a brain asleep. One eye open. And still breathing. That is how a dolphin sleeps without drowning.
